title: Orientation, Polytonic Greek, Manuscript Selection & Local Git Version Control
query: How do local Git version control workflows and Unicode polytonic Greek standards support undergraduate digital scholarly editing, manuscript selection, and reproducible editorial audit trails?

results.title: The Perseids Platform: Scholarship for all!
results.authors_venue_year: [PDF][PDF] The Perseids Platform: Scholarship for all!B Almas, MC Beaulieu - Digital Classics Outside the Echo …, 2016 - ubiquitypress.comUtilizes a Git-based revision control system to enable collaborative editing, which includes workflow tools and a built-in, versioned review process for all contributions.Undergraduate Scholarly Editing: Supports student engagement in editorial tasks, such as transcribing and translating source text in TEI XML, demonstrating how undergraduates can contribute to digital scholarly editing.Editorial Audit Trails: Records and vets every change via an approval process involving targeted review boards, ensuring a reliable and reproducible editorial audit trail for publications which are always backed by raw XML and annotations.Save Cite Cited by 30 Related articles All 12 versions  View as HTML [PDF] tufts.edu

results.title: Developing a new integrated editing platform for source documents in classics
results.authors_venue_year: Developing a new integrated editing platform for source documents in classicsB Almas, MC Beaulieu - Literary and linguistic computing, 2013 - academic.oup.comExplains the Perseids online editing platform facilitates collaborative publishing of professional transcriptions, editions, translations, annotations, and commentaries of source documents for students and scholars.Git Version Control Workflow: Details how the editorial workflow is built on top of a Git version control repository, leveraging a workflow engine and user-specific clones for version control and review processes to ensure editorial audit trails.Document Selection and Evidence: Supports undergraduate editing by providing access to high-resolution pictures of documents, such as Greek inscriptions, allowing editors to indicate readings and editorial choices with justifications in the apparatus criticus and commentary.Save Cite Cited by 36 Related articles All 10 versions  No full text available [PDF] springer.com

results.title: Committing to reproducibility and explainability: using Git as a research journal
results.authors_venue_year: Committing to reproducibility and explainability: using Git as a research journalSJ Huskey - International Journal of Digital Humanities, 2024 - SpringerArgues that viewing distributed, version-controlled data repositories, such as Git, empowers users, including students, to follow the choices and methods of Digital Humanities (DH) researchers and to reproduce their work, promoting an explainable research culture.Git Workflow Guidelines: Proposes guidelines for using Git in DH research publication to promote reproducibility and explainability, drawing parallels between Git and the critical apparatus of traditional editions which allows readers to evaluate editorial evidence and judgment.Git Commit Log as Audit Trail: Suggests using Git's commit log as a research journal, which provides a step-by-step editorial audit trail, offering different insights into the method and process behind the final narrative description of a project for scholars, collaborators, and students.Save Cite Cited by 6 Related articles All 2 versions  No full text available Looking for more results...Scholar Labs is currently not designed for queries like this.Suggestions:Try a different questionTry your query on Google ScholarNo results found.Search stopped.Looking for results...Scholar Labs is currently not designed for queries like this.Suggestions:Try a different questionTry your query on Google ScholarNo results found.Search stopped.An error occurred.RetryMore resultsReady to explore your own questions and answers?Ask your questionScholar Labs is experimental and can make mistakes.Help & PrivacyPrivacyTermsHelpYou're on the waitlistScholar Labs home
